prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic high-key red-carpet event portrait of a generic adult white fashion model with a chin-length platinum-blonde Old Hollywood glam bob, deep side part and voluminous waves, blue eyes and a fair glowing complexion. She has a confident relaxed gaze and stands waist-up with her shoulders slightly angled. She wears a vintage-style cream and off-white evening gown heavily embellished with silver crystals and beads in a diamond lattice pattern, with a strapless neckline and a thick ruched white silk chiffon sash draped around the upper arms. Add dangling diamond drop earrings, diamond rings and soft glam makeup with nude pink lipstick, subtle eyeliner, voluminous lashes and dewy cheekbone highlights. Set her against a matte beige-tan event photo wall with large gold 3D fictional event lettering behind her head. Use professional high-key event lighting, soft distinct shadows, glossy crystal highlights, sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field and vertical portrait framing. Preserve the gown, sash, hairstyle and red-carpet mood without reproducing Sydney Sweeney or any public-figure likeness.
